name: Visagar Polytex Limited
about: Visagar Polytex Limited engages in the design, manufacture, wholesale, retail, and trade of textiles primarily in India. The company offers ethnic wear, including sarees, lehengas, and suits; and interlining goods, as well as various fabrics. It sells its products under the Vividha brand. Visagar Polytex Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
